items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he had been with Mel Torme and this is where they got him from.

ctx.x: Yeah, he had been with Mel Torme and this is where they got him from. And, see, usually they play with trios and things like that. So this is the secret of that, the band, the big band drummer. He's got to take command. He's the general, really, he's the general. And he can be soft as cotton, playing soft as cotton -- what did they use to say, he's so soft you could hear a chinch piss on a cotton.
